entries.resultText: The working fizzles and fails without further harm, but the materials are spoiled.
The power slips sideways. A brief, harmless but unsettling omen appears nearby.

effect.payloadValue: A brief unsettling omen (GM describes).

entries.resultText: The caster is left spiritually winded and weak for a time.
The rite lingers imperfectly; the spell cannot be attempted again until the next dawn.
The working leaves a small mark on the caster's body — a brand, pallor, or thin scar.
entries.resultNotes: Cosmetic body mark in the bio.

effect.payloadValue: A small physical mark left by the working (GM/player describes).

entries.resultText: The caster's voice fails; words will not come for a while.
Sleep will not come easily; the caster is left restless and ill at ease.
The rite plants a small, nagging compulsion in the caster.

effect.payloadValue: A small new compulsion tied to the rite (GM/player phrases it).

entries.resultText: The caster is struck by backlash and suffers a real weakening of body and spirit.
The spell fastens to the wrong target: the caster, a helper, or a sympathetic object nearby.
entries.resultNotes: GM redirects the intended effect (or a softened version) to the wrong target.

effect.payloadValue: The working's effect lands on the wrong target.

entries.resultText: Something from the other side takes notice and turns its attention on the caster.
entries.resultNotes: Relational hook — GM names what now watches/follows.

effect.payloadValue: Noticed by a being from the other side (GM names it).

entries.resultText: The rite leaves a stain in the place; threshold, room, or grave becomes spiritually troubled.

effect.payloadValue: A spiritually troubled, stained place.

entries.resultText: The failure brands the caster with a lasting occult mark.

effect.payloadValue: Witches' mark
effect.payloadNotes: Grant a Curse Supernatural Mark, e.g. Witches' mark or Ritual scars.

entries.resultText: The caster's voice is taken; speech will not return until the loss is lifted.
Strain binds to the caster; later rites of the same school are harder until cleansed.
The working plants a deep new drive — an obsession the caster cannot easily shake.

effect.payloadValue: A strong new drive or obsession from the rite (GM/player phrases it).

entries.resultText: A being from the other side is now your enemy — and it knows you.
entries.resultNotes: Relational hook — GM fleshes out the hostile being and its pursuit.

effect.payloadValue: A named being from beyond is now hostile and hunts the caster (GM fleshes it out).

entries.resultText: The failure tears a way open; something can cross over here.

effect.payloadValue: An open crossing lingers in the place; GM fleshes what crosses and when.
effect.notes: Frontier: needs the battlefield-effect system; GM-handled for now.

entries.resultText: An unhealthy bond forms — a being from the other side is now tied to the caster.
entries.resultNotes: An unwanted pact (GM sets patron, obligation, tension).

effect.payloadValue: An unwanted, nascent pact with a being from beyond (GM sets patron, obligation, and tension).

entries.resultText: The caster is spiritually torn; a lasting curse settles into them.

effect.payloadValue: Soul leakage
effect.payloadNotes: Grant a Curse Supernatural Mark, e.g. Soul leakage, Corrupted, or Witches' mark.

entries.resultText: Fortune turns its face away; the caster is marked for worsening misfortune.
The caster is seized by backlash and collapses, body and soul.
entries.resultNotes: Heavy HP damage; on a hard fall also Exhausted.

entries.resultText: Something is taken in the crossing — a name, a voice, warmth, or a shadow — and does not return.
entries.resultNotes: Permanent loss; GM picks what is taken and the matching stat.

effect.payloadNotes: GM picks what is taken (name, voice, warmth, shadow) and the matching permanent step loss.

entries.resultText: The spell binds itself permanently into the wrong thing — a tool, corpse, vessel, or living bystander.
entries.resultNotes: Creates a cursed object or haunted bystander.

effect.payloadValue: A cursed object, vessel, or haunted bystander.

entries.resultText: The chill of the grave clings to the caster; limbs grow heavy and the spirit gutters.

effect.onPartial: Weakened for a single round instead of the scene.

entries.resultText: Corpse-taint seeps into the working, and the caster sickens with the rot of what was disturbed.
entries.resultNotes: Corpse-contact contagion — the caster rolls a disease contraction (disease-service).

effect.payloadValue: a corpse-borne disease

entries.resultText: A shade takes notice. Something among the dead now watches, follows, or remembers the caster.

effect.payloadValue: Watched by the dead

entries.resultText: The nearest grave, bone, or remains will not lie still; the place turns restless.

effect.payloadValue: Restless dead

entries.resultText: The dead disturb the caster's rest. Sleep brings cold dreams and no peace.
Something grave-cold drinks the caster's vigour to sustain itself.
The working fastens to nearby remains instead of its mark, waking a small wrongness in them.
entries.resultNotes: Binds to remains, or redirect SuccessEffects onto them.

effect.payloadValue: Corpse or relic

entries.resultText: The caster takes on the grave's pallor: a cold, corpse-touched tell the watchful can read.

effect.payloadValue: Grave-pallor

entries.resultText: The dead walk. A revenant or hungry shade tears loose from the rite, beyond the caster's command.
entries.resultNotes: The being is loosed — the headline undead disaster.

effect.payloadValue: Hostile undead (revenant or shade)
effect.onPartial: The dead thing is loosed but slow, confused, or bound to the site for now.

entries.resultText: The dead fix upon the caster and will not be turned aside; they are marked for the grave's pursuit.
The spell binds itself permanently into a corpse, relic, or vessel, animating its wrongness.

effect.payloadValue: Animated remains

entries.resultText: The ground itself is fouled with death; the place becomes a dead-haunted danger until cleansed.

effect.payloadValue: Dead-haunted ground

entries.resultText: Warmth is taken in the crossing. Something of the caster's living heat is given to the dead and does not return.

effect.onPartial: The loss is temporary, returning after a long rest.

entries.resultText: The disturbed dead lay a curse upon the one who woke them.

effect.payloadValue: Soul leakage
effect.payloadNotes: Grant the Soul leakage Curse Supernatural Mark.

entries.resultText: The grave reaches back. The caster is seized by deathly strain and collapses, body and soul.

effect.onPartial: Half damage and no lasting wound.

entries.resultText: A path to the dead is left open. The veil between here and the grave is thinned, and worse may follow.
entries.resultNotes: Battlefield effect (not yet a built system) — narrative until then.

effect.payloadValue: An open crossing to the dead lingers in the place
effect.notes: Frontier: needs the battlefield-effect system; GM-handled for now.

entries.resultText: Something hidden now watches and follows the caster, just out of sight.
entries.resultNotes: Relational hook — GM names the watcher.

effect.payloadValue: Watched and followed by a hidden being (GM names it).

entries.resultText: The hidden disturb the caster's rest; sleep brings whispers and no peace.
Judgement and paths slip sideways; the caster is subtly misled.

effect.payloadValue: Thoughts and ways turn astray.

entries.resultText: A faint glamour clings to the caster — an uncanny tell the watchful can read.

effect.payloadValue: A faint glamour-tell on the caster (GM/player describes).

entries.resultText: Before the hidden, the caster's words falter and fail.
An unasked-for gift or favour is pressed on the caster, and a debt with it.
entries.resultNotes: A nagging fae-debt; GM may grow it.

effect.payloadValue: A compulsion to repay or return an unwanted hidden-folk debt.

entries.resultText: A threshold or boundary near the rite is weakened and troubled.

effect.payloadValue: A weakened, troubled threshold.

entries.resultText: The hidden take a little of the caster's vigour for themselves.
One of the Unseen crosses over, drawn and angered by the rite.

effect.payloadValue: An Unseen power (GM details).
effect.onPartial: It crosses but is slow, bound to the site, or briefly bargaining.

entries.resultText: A way opens between here and the hidden world.

effect.payloadValue: A crossing to the hidden world lingers here.
effect.notes: Frontier: GM-handled until the battlefield-effect system lands.

entries.resultText: A bargain is struck, whether the caster willed it or not.

effect.payloadValue: A forced pact with an Unseen patron (GM sets obligation and tension).

entries.resultText: The hidden now know the caster's true name, and will use it.

effect.payloadValue: The caster's true name is known to the Unseen, who can call and bind by it.

entries.resultText: The caster's fate is tangled into the hidden world — a lasting curse.

effect.payloadValue: Fate bound
effect.payloadNotes: Grant the Fate bound Curse Supernatural Mark.

entries.resultText: Something is carried across — a name, a year of life, warmth, or a shadow — and does not return.
entries.resultNotes: Permanent loss; GM picks what is taken.

effect.payloadNotes: GM picks what is taken and the matching permanent step loss.

entries.resultText: Night is no longer safe; the dark answers to the hidden now.

effect.payloadValue: Nightbound
effect.payloadNotes: Grant the Nightbound Curse Supernatural Mark.

entries.resultText: The hidden mark the caster for worsening misfortune.
A corrupting touch weakens the caster's body and spirit.
The unnatural brands the caster with a tell the discerning can read.

effect.payloadValue: An unnatural brand or tell on the caster.

entries.resultText: Intrusive whispers gnaw at the caster; rest is poisoned.
A tempting compulsion is planted, sweet and wrong.

effect.payloadValue: A tempting, unnatural compulsion (GM/player phrases it).

entries.resultText: The place is fouled with unnatural taint.

effect.payloadValue: Ground fouled with unnatural taint.

entries.resultText: A minor curse clings to the caster.
An object of the rite is claimed and twisted by the unnatural.

effect.payloadValue: An object twisted by unnatural claim.

entries.resultText: The unnatural presence drinks the caster's vigour.
An unnatural thing breaks loose, manifest and beyond the caster's control.

effect.payloadValue: A manifest unnatural being (demon, conjured horror — GM details).
effect.onPartial: It manifests but weak, contained, or briefly bargaining.

entries.resultText: The unnatural seizes the caster's body and will.

effect.payloadValue: Spirit possession

entries.resultText: A pact is forced upon the caster, signed in spite of themselves.

effect.payloadValue: A forced devil's bargain (GM sets obligation and tension).

entries.resultText: A lasting corruption settles into the caster.

effect.payloadValue: Corrupted
effect.payloadNotes: Grant the Corrupted Curse Supernatural Mark.

entries.resultText: An unnatural, hollow hunger takes root and will not be fed.

effect.payloadValue: Hollow hunger
effect.payloadNotes: Grant the Hollow hunger Curse Supernatural Mark.

entries.resultText: The spell inverts: the blessing becomes a curse, the ward an opening.

effect.payloadValue: The working's broad intent is reversed.

entries.resultText: The spell binds permanently into the wrong vessel — a tool, corpse, or bystander.

effect.payloadValue: A cursed vessel or possessed bystander.

entries.resultText: The caster is marked for ruin and worsening misfortune.
The place turns cold to the caster; nothing sits easy here.
A land-wight takes notice of the one who disturbed its seat.
entries.resultNotes: Relational hook — GM names the wight.

effect.payloadValue: A nature spirit of the place now watches the caster (GM names it).

entries.resultText: The land draws the strength from the caster's limbs.
Paths twist and the caster loses the way out.

effect.payloadValue: Routes twist; the caster loses the way.

entries.resultText: A small blight settles on crop, beast, or the spot itself.

effect.payloadValue: A small blight on the place.

entries.resultText: A leaf-brand, bark-rough patch, or mossy tell marks the caster.

effect.payloadValue: A green or earthen mark on the caster.

entries.resultText: An aversion begins to take root — the touch of worked iron now grates.

effect.payloadValue: A new aversion (e.g. to cold iron) takes root.

entries.resultText: The land takes its tithe of the caster's vigour.
A nature spirit rises in wrath, manifest and beyond appeasement.

effect.payloadValue: An angered nature spirit (GM details).
effect.onPartial: It rises but slow, bound to its seat, or open to appeasement.

entries.resultText: The ground itself turns hostile and claimed; it no longer suffers the caster.

effect.payloadValue: The place is claimed and turns hostile to the caster.

entries.resultText: A bargain with the wild is forced upon the caster.

effect.payloadValue: A forced pact with the spirit of the place (GM sets obligation and tension).

entries.resultText: A lasting blight roots itself in the caster.

effect.payloadValue: Blighting
effect.payloadNotes: Grant the Blighting Curse Supernatural Mark.

entries.resultText: The caster is led away and lost in the spirit's domain.
entries.resultNotes: Severe leading-astray; GM may strand the caster.

effect.payloadValue: The caster is led deep into the wild and lost.

entries.resultText: Something bestial takes root in the caster's blood.

effect.payloadValue: Beast blood
effect.payloadNotes: Grant the Beast blood Curse Supernatural Mark.

entries.resultText: A spirit-borne sickness takes the caster — fire of the limbs.

effect.payloadValue: St Anthony's Fire

entries.resultText: The land lays its doom on the caster.
